messages:
anika: Postmortem follow-up from the authz disruption this morning. Root cause summary: rotation orchestration allowed validator restarts before gateway caches were flushed, producing a ~2m window of stale claims. At the same time, the audit pipeline experienced a consumer rebalance and we lost a short span of events. Need owners, short remediation steps, and a verification cadence.
raj: Thanks. Minimal repro or quick mitigation list?
anika: Minimal repro in incident doc: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/incident/2290025555. Sequence: rotation job updates secret -> validators restart -> gateway keeps cached claims until TTL or 401 triggers revalidation. If revalidation coincides with kafka consumer rebalance GC spikes, some events never reach the sink. Quick mitigations: (A) gate validator restarts behind an atomic rotation checkpoint, (B) force cache flush on rotation event, (C) add a short local buffer + idempotent retry for audit shipper.
mike: I can take the orchestration gating work (atomic commit + restart gate). I'll make it rollback-safe and feature-flagged. ETA: Thu COB.
raj: I'll own the gateway defensive path: on 401 do a synchronous revalidate with a 150ms timeout and a backoff circuit to avoid amplification. Add an e2e test simulating rotation + deploy ordering. ETA: Mon.
infra-sre: I'll harden the audit shipper: bounded local buffer (60s), idempotent sink retries, and tune consumer-lag alerts to page at 2500+ lag. Also propose a short-lived throttle for rotation jobs if lag is high. ETA: tomorrow morning.
anika: Nice. Consolidating action items here so oncall has one source:
- [ ] MIKE: PR for rotation -> restart gate + atomic commit (feature flag).
- [ ] RAJ: revalidate-on-401 sync call + integration tests and circuit breaker.
- [ ] INFRA-SRE: audit-shipper buffer + idempotent retry + alert rule.
- [ ] ANIKA: update runbook: "force-refresh tokens" snippet, add rollout/rollback checklist and smoke-test curl.

anika: Smoke-test curl for oncall:
`curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROTATED_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/health`
If you see a spike in 401s: run `scripts/force-refresh-tokens --service gateway --dry-run` then escalate to infra-sre.

mike: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/orch/pulls/211 - includes feature flag `rotation.gate_v1` and a kill-switch. Requesting review from @raj and @infra-sre.
raj: Test harness PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/gateway/pulls/231 - revalidate-on-401 + deploy-order e2e and latency guard. Requesting review from @mike.
infra-sre: Infra PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/pulls/980 - local buffer + idempotent retry + consumer-lag alert. Added temporary rotation throttle: limit to 1 concurrent rotation job per region.
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-3419: "rotation-orchestration-handoff" and linked SRV-4878. Watchers: anika, raj, mike, infra-sre. Status: in_progress.
anika: Scheduling a 20m handoff tomorrow 09:45 PST to walk rollout and rollback criteria. Bring PR links, kill-switch scripts, and smoke-test outputs.
raj: I'll bring trace spans and the revalidation test logs.
mike: I'll bring rollout steps and the gate activation script.
infra-sre: I'll bring consumer-lag dashboards and throttle config.
anika: Final ask: run a short 2-week verification cadence: weekly consumer-lag snapshot & a short post-deploy smoke test for rotations. We'll do daily 10m standups for the first 3 working days while items are open. :thumbsup:
raj: ack
mike: ack
infra-sre: ack
ops-bot: SEC-3419 status updated: owners assigned, due date in 7 days."
